conditions: Use separate table identifiers and titles: route slots for X4, physical assets for Y2.
Never compare X4 R_d or candidate_total directly with Y2 physical-vehicle counts without the trips-to-assets mapping.
Only Y2 can support the paper's retained physical multi-trip fleet claim.
X4 can explain why a route-count fleet rule overstates assets and why its 75/81 all-EV result does not transfer to fixed physical-trip chains.
main_text_rule: Do not place both as two estimates of one experiment. If X4 is retained, label it a restricted single-trip diagnostic and place it outside the main multitrip level table.
x4_disposition: route-level single-trip diagnostic or appendix only; not a coequal fleet-sizing result
